name: designcore-excalidraw-export
description: Headless Excalidraw SVG export helper for DesignCore.
comment: @excalidraw/utils is pinned to an exact prerelease on purpose.
0.1.2 (the latest stable) ships dist/excalidraw-utils.min.js, which throws
under the jsdom shim; 0.1.3-test32 ships dist/prod/index.js, which is the
build the Task 2 probe verified. A caret range would silently select the
broken stable release, because npm ranges do not match prereleases.
